body: Revenue monthly digest — fixture day 240, 2027-09-01. A source audit revises the compact experiment's SAME original 10,000 sessions per arm. Measurement-11 (settled-order-ledger-v3 with mature cancellations) replaces measurement-8's reported +7% with revenue/session 5.00 detailed versus 4.80 compact: -0.20 (-4%), 95% difference interval [-0.30, -0.10]. Refund rates remain 2% in each arm and checkout errors 0.2%; separate guardrail uncertainty bounds are unavailable. This is a measurement correction, not a new experiment or recovery result. The actual day-0 deployment effect-4 and day-14 adoption effect-9 remain in history. Under standing rollback authority, I restored detailed with wallet tracking true using a rollout (effect-12). Actual status verifies revision 3, no open experiment and four related evaluations. Compatible footer work is unchanged; the analytics audit is incorporated. Measurement-13 verifies exposure at revision 3 but is immature (80 sessions per arm) and repeats the original-session audit, including measurement-11 in its correction list; its sample/window information does not establish post-restoration revenue recovery. A later observation is confirmed for fixture day 254, 2027-09-15, by schedule effect-14 and actual scheduler status. That review will check new settled revenue, refunds, errors, cohort definitions, maturity and any further correction before judging recovery. No validation credits were spent: the shared project-credit-ledger remains 9/10 consumed with no reset. No new experiment or reservation was opened. The ongoing responsibility remains active; no owner decision is needed. Original evidence, linked correction, exact action requests and receipts are retained in memory/actions/day-240-source-audit.md and memory/evidence/.
